notes: Packaged launches load the main bundle through Node's compile cache. src/main/boot.ts is the new package.json main (out/main/boot.js, 929 bytes, a second rollupOptions.input of the main section; it imports only electron, node builtins and compileCache.ts, so Rollup emits no out/main/chunks and index.js still loads alone): when app.isPackaged it calls enableCompileCache on compileCacheDir (TEMP_CODE_COMPILE_CACHE, else $TMPDIR/temp-code/compile-cache, T3 Code's choice; macOS purges it after three idle days, so one cold compile then warm), logs one '[boot] compile-cache ENABLED <dir>' | FAILED <message> | DISABLED | ALREADY_ENABLED line, swallows any throw, and requires index.js by a computed path. Dev launches pass through it with the cache off (checked: an isolated electron-vite dev instance logs 'index … compile-cache=off'). Node writes the cache only at its own exit, which Electron's quit never reaches, so index.ts flushes it 10 s after openSavedWindows (unref'd) and first thing in the real-quit branch of before-quit, for modules required lazily since; both are no-ops when the cache is off. compileCache.ts is pure (compileCacheDir, compileCacheLine) with compileCache.test.ts. The harness (scripts/e2e-launch-timing.ts) now gives stdout and stderr one shared file description (two offsets had overwritten the first [boot] line with Node's SQLite warning), parses v8.compileModule beside v8.compile (the renderer's index bundle is a module script, so its cold cost is v8.parseOnBackground, now a column) and any v8.produce* event, packs into build-<label> so a later run keeps an earlier bundle, and reads package.json after the release train. Baseline on the file:// tree, four traced launches: index 176–186 ms, ready-to-show 632–657 ms, tc:ready 819–933 ms since process start; the index bundle streams and parses 70.6–73.0 ms on every launch, no v8.produceCache, no consumedCacheSize, Code Cache/js stays at its 8 KB index. CLAUDE.md gains the launch-time code caches section.
